scope.summary: Lists get an optional description, set when creating or editing a list and shown on the list page and on the share page.

interface.ui: Create and edit forms get a field labelled "Description" (optional, at most 500 characters). The list page and the share page show the description (when present) as text directly below the h1.

criteria.when: she creates a list with a description, and edits it to a different description
criteria.then: the list page shows the current description, also after a reload

criteria.given: a list with a description and a share link
criteria.when: the share link is opened anonymously

criteria.given: alice on the create or edit form
criteria.when: she submits a description longer than 500 characters
criteria.then: nothing is saved and a role=alert element mentions "description"; exactly 500 characters are accepted

criteria.when: it is viewed, shared and edited
criteria.then: it works as before and shows no empty description placeholder text
